subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine recovery archives be silently limited to five files, and if so what retention, operator visibility, and cleanup contract should OpenClaw support?
rationale: The cap prevents disk growth but changes persistent recovery-data semantics by deleting older archives; code review cannot safely choose that user-data retention policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve five-file silent retention
options.body: Accept the current bounded-disk policy and document/test that the oldest recovery archives are discarded after five files.

options.title: Choose an explicit recovery-data policy
options.body: Define an owner-approved retention and operator-cleanup/visibility contract, then revise this branch to implement and test that policy.

options.title: Keep archival without automatic deletion
options.body: Retain all archives for now and address disk budgeting through a separately approved cleanup design.

recommendation.title: Choose an explicit recovery-data policy
recommendation.body: Define an owner-approved retention and operator-cleanup/visibility contract, then revise this branch to implement and test that policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline explicitly routes the retention question to this person, although local feature-history provenance could not be established.
